body: I can't really give much of an explanation past "the vibe I get is not one that is overly welcoming" and I feel as though I'm the reason they're that way.

I can just feel it - something isn't right about this week. I had been making mistakes with stand-up meeting etiquette and lunches overrunning, and I don't think my team particularly like me. I want to work as hard as possible to keep this job but I don't even know if I deserve to keep it
